name: AI Lead Qualification System
description: Scores inbound leads 0-100 with AI, alerts sales on hot leads and logs every lead to Google Sheets.

name: AI Appointment Scheduler
description: Reads free-text booking requests, extracts date/time with AI, creates a Google Calendar event and emails a confirmation (or asks for missing details).

name: AI Email Responder
description: Watches the inbox, classifies each unread email, auto-replies to routine ones and escalates sensitive ones to Slack.

name: AI Follow-Up Automation
description: Every morning reviews leads in Google Sheets and sends personalised follow-up emails to contacts that went quiet.

name: AI Proposal Generator
description: Turns discovery-call notes into a structured sales proposal, emails the draft to the account owner and logs it.

name: AI Invoice Automation
description: Extracts line items, totals and due dates from invoice text/OCR, validates the maths and books valid invoices to Sheets.

name: AI Payment Reminder System
description: Daily scan of unpaid invoices; AI writes reminders with tone matched to how overdue they are and escalates 30+ days.

name: AI Customer Onboarding
description: When a new customer signs up, AI builds a personalised onboarding plan and welcome email; enterprise accounts get a CSM alert.

name: AI Support Ticket Triage
description: Classifies incoming tickets by category, priority and sentiment, routes urgent ones to on-call and posts a suggested first reply.

name: AI Knowledge Base Assistant
description: Answers questions from your knowledge-base content (fetched from a URL) and flags gaps when the KB has no answer.

name: AI Social Media Scheduler
description: Daily picks the next topic from a content calendar sheet, writes platform-specific posts and queues them via your scheduling API (e.g. Buffer).

name: AI Content Repurposer
description: Takes a blog post or transcript and repurposes it into a newsletter, LinkedIn post, X thread, short-video script and quote cards.

name: AI Review Manager
description: Analyses new customer reviews, drafts on-brand responses and escalates negative reviews to the team.

name: AI Data Entry Automation
description: Converts unstructured text (emails, forms, notes) into clean structured records and appends them to Google Sheets.

name: AI Document Classifier
description: Classifies documents (invoice, contract, resume, receipt...) from their text, extracts key metadata and routes them.

name: AI Meeting Notes Assistant
description: Turns a meeting transcript into a summary, decisions and owner-assigned action items, then shares them on Slack and email.

name: AI CRM Updater
description: Reads call notes or email threads and pushes structured updates (stage, next step, deal value) to your CRM API.

name: AI Pipeline Management
description: Weekly review of every open deal: AI flags stalled or at-risk deals and recommends next actions to the sales channel.

name: AI Inventory Monitor
description: Checks stock levels every 6 hours, predicts stock-out dates from sales velocity and recommends reorder quantities.

name: AI Order Processing
description: Validates incoming orders, scores fraud risk, confirms good orders to the customer and holds risky ones for review.

name: AI Shipping Automation
description: Interprets carrier tracking events, writes customer-friendly status updates and flags delays or exceptions.

name: AI Expense Categorizer
description: Categorises expenses/receipts against your chart of accounts, flags policy violations and logs to the expense sheet.

name: AI Report Generator
description: Every Monday pulls metrics from your data endpoint and writes an executive weekly report with highlights and risks.

name: AI Sales Assistant
description: Chat-style webhook that answers prospect questions about your product, captures buying signals and hands off hot prospects.

name: AI Upsell Recommender
description: Analyses a customer usage/purchase profile and recommends the best upsell or cross-sell with a tailored pitch.

name: AI Churn Prediction
description: Daily scores every account for churn risk from usage and support signals and alerts CS on high-risk accounts.

name: AI Feedback Analyzer
description: Analyses product feedback for sentiment, themes and feature requests and routes critical bugs to the product team.

name: AI Survey Automation
description: Hosts a survey form, analyses each response with AI (NPS, sentiment, themes) and follows up with detractors.

name: AI Webinar Automation
description: Handles webinar registrations: personalised confirmation, lead scoring from registration answers and sales alerts.

name: AI Job Application Screener
description: Scores CVs against the job description, summarises strengths/gaps and fast-tracks strong candidates.

name: AI Interview Scheduler
description: Proposes interview slots from interviewer availability, books the calendar event and emails the candidate.

name: AI Employee Onboarding
description: Creates a role-specific onboarding plan and welcome email for new hires and notifies IT/manager of setup tasks.

name: AI Timesheet Collector
description: Every Friday reviews timesheets, chases missing entries with friendly reminders and flags overtime anomalies.

name: AI Compliance Checker
description: Checks policies, marketing copy or contracts against GDPR/brand/regulatory rules and reports violations with fixes.

name: AI Contract Analyzer
description: Extracts parties, dates, value and key clauses from contracts and highlights risky terms for legal review.

name: AI Project Status Reporter
description: Every Friday pulls tasks from your PM tool API and writes a RAG-status project report for stakeholders.

name: AI Task Automation
description: Turns free-text requests ("remind Priya to send the deck by Thursday") into structured, prioritised tasks in your task tool.

name: AI File Organizer
description: Suggests a clean file name, folder path and tags for every uploaded file based on its name and content preview.

name: AI Transcription Automation
description: Transcribes audio from a URL with OpenAI Whisper, then summarises it and extracts action items.

name: AI Language Translator
description: Translates text into one or more target languages preserving tone and formatting, with a quality self-check.

name: AI Voice Assistant
description: Accepts a voice note URL, transcribes it with Whisper, answers/acts on the request and returns a spoken MP3 reply via OpenAI TTS.

name: AI Competitor Monitor
description: Daily fetches competitor pages, has AI compare against the last snapshot and reports meaningful changes.

name: AI Price Monitoring
description: Every 4 hours checks product pages for prices, compares with your price and recommends adjustments.

name: AI Local SEO Monitor
description: Weekly audits your local business listing / landing page for NAP consistency, keywords and review signals, with fixes.

name: AI Ad Performance Monitor
description: Daily pulls ad campaign metrics, detects wasted spend and anomalies and recommends budget shifts.

name: AI Client Communication Hub
description: One inbox webhook for every client channel (email, WhatsApp, chat, forms): AI classifies, drafts replies and routes to the right owner.

name: AI Backup Automation
description: Nightly exports every n8n workflow via the n8n API to a GitHub repo and has AI summarise what changed.

name: AI System Health Monitor
description: Pings your endpoints every 5 minutes; AI diagnoses failures/slow responses and alerts with likely causes.

name: AI Workflow Orchestrator
description: A single smart entry point: AI reads any incoming request and routes it to the right automation webhook (lead, ticket, invoice, meeting notes...).

name: AI Business Insights Dashboard
description: Daily combines sales, marketing, support and finance metrics into an AI-written insights digest and logs KPIs for a dashboard.
